zh: 两轮车和四轮车的轮子数都是偶数，所以轮子总数为奇数时无解；方案只由两类车各有多少辆决定，不考虑排列。
轮子数为偶数 w 时，四轮车的数量可以是 0 到 ⌊w/4⌋ 中的任意一个，每个取值都唯一确定两轮车的数量。
对每个查询：w 为奇数输出 0，否则输出 ⌊w/4⌋ + 1；按输入顺序逐行输出。
en: Both two-wheelers and four-wheelers have an even number of wheels, so an odd total has no solution; an option is determined only by how many vehicles of each type there are, not by their order.
For an even total w, the number of four-wheelers can be any value from 0 to floor(w/4), and each choice fixes the number of two-wheelers uniquely.
For each query print 0 if w is odd, otherwise floor(w/4) + 1, one line per query in input order.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Odd totals are impossible; for an even total, the number of four-wheelers ranges from 0 to w//4, and each such count uniquely determines the number of two-wheelers.

## Proof of correctness

Both vehicle types have an even number of wheels, so odd totals have no solution. For an even total, every four-wheeler count in 0..floor(w/4) leaves a non-negative even number of wheels, which corresponds to a unique number of two-wheelers, so the number of options is floor(w/4)+1.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(n) output space.
